lines.en: Hi Omar! You look like someone who has just won an argument. What happened?
Hi Sara. Not exactly won, but I did defend my position calmly, and I managed to change several minds in the room.
What was the argument about this time?
It is often said that social media divides people, but I argued that it simply reveals divisions that already existed.
What really matters is not who wins the argument, but whether you got closer to the truth. Did you?
I think so. Although one colleague kept repeating claims he could not support with evidence.
It is pointless arguing with someone who has already made up their mind.
True. By the way, congratulations on your promotion. You are said to be the youngest manager the company has ever had.
Thank you. It was not talent that got me here, but years of disciplined practice.
However hard you work, there will always be someone who doubts you. How do you deal with that?
I treat every failure as a lesson rather than a defeat, and I stopped trying to please everyone.
If only I had learned that earlier, I would have avoided so many mistakes.
Not until we lose something do we understand what really matters. That is life.
Speaking of changes, I heard they want to demolish the old market downtown.
Under no circumstances should historic buildings be demolished to make room for parking lots.
I agree. The old market is believed to be more than six hundred years old.
The bigger the city grows, the harder it becomes to protect its history and its green spaces.
If the government were to invest more in public transport, the center would not be such a daily struggle.
However crowded the metro gets in the morning, it is still faster than driving across the city.
Changing the subject, did you read about the new discovery on Mars?
Yes. It is widely believed that water once flowed on its surface. Imagine that.
Not until recently have researchers been able to study it in such detail.
However advanced our technology becomes, there will always be questions we cannot answer.
That is what makes science beautiful. Are you still painting in your free time?
Every weekend. What draws me to art is not its price, but the feelings it awakens in me.
Not only does music express what words cannot, but painting does too, in your case.
If I had learned to paint as a child, I would be a very different person today.
It is never too late. However difficult the first attempts may seem, every artist was once a beginner.
What matters in art is not perfection, but honesty. A painting must say something true.
Just like a good argument. Take care, Sara, and keep painting.
And you keep winning those arguments, Omar. See you soon!
